title: Link Click
synopsis:
In a corner of a bustling city, there is a small shop called "Time Photo Studio" operating as usual. Although the entrance looks abandoned, it's actually run by two men with special abilities: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang. In order to fulfil customers' requests, Lu Guang and Cheng Xiaoshi work together and use their special abilities to enter photos. However, things don't go as planned...

(Source: bilibili, translated)

Note: The final episode aired with a runtime of ~31 minutes.

episodes.title: EMMA
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang dive into a corporate audit case using a photograph taken by a young CFO assistant named Emma, aiming to uncover financial fraud without altering her tragic personal fate.

episodes.title: Secret Recipe
episodes.synopsis: A client hires Time Photo Studio to acquire a secret ramen noodle broth recipe from an estranged business partner, leading Cheng Xiaoshi to experience the deep passion and bonds of friendship.

episodes.title: To Lose, Not To Win
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi travels back to a pivotal high school basketball championship game with strict instructions: play his heart out, but ensure the team loses.

episodes.title: Confess
episodes.synopsis: Continuing inside the 2008 basketball memories, Cheng Xiaoshi learns the heavy weight of unspoken feelings and childhood camaraderie before disaster strikes.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi experiences the emotional heartbreak of May 12, 2008, witnessing the final moments shared between loved ones before an inevitable catastrophe.

episodes.title: Search of The Child
episodes.synopsis: A desperate couple comes to the photo studio seeking any clue about their son, Doudou, who was abducted three years prior.

episodes.title: Aunt May
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi enters the memory of a street vendor, Aunt May, piecing together the harrowing kidnapping trail to save a child across time.

episodes.title: Lost Signal
episodes.synopsis: Police Captain Xiao invites the duo to assist in identifying a serial killer operating in City Q, drawing the team into their most dangerous case.

episodes.title: Consequence of Goodwill
episodes.synopsis: As the investigation into the serial murders tightens, Lu Guang notices alarming discrepancies in the timeline that trace back to Emma.

episodes.title: Trap
episodes.synopsis: The killer takes violent action against those closest to the studio, cornering Cheng Xiaoshi in a lethal game of photographic cat-and-mouse.

episodes.title: Pinnacle of Light
episodes.synopsis: In a breathtaking season finale, shocking revelations about the killer’s supernatural control threaten everything Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang fought to protect.
